question: The user read back 3f2c… for spec launch/fs_launch_spec.q27.json. Seal the confirmation.
ground_truth: The agent loads the confirm-before-launch skill and recomputes the plan hash (fskills hash --spec, the same token fskills launch --confirm requires) over the spec payload; matching the one the user read back, it seals a confirmation_record with confirmed_by=user and auto_filled=false and submits nothing.
expected_behavior: The agent read confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md before acting
The agent recomputed the plan hash from the fs_launch_spec payload and matched it against the hash the user read back
The agent wrote a confirmation_record with confirmed_by=user and auto_filled=false (confirmed_hash verbatim from the user)
The agent never printed or filled the expected hash for the caller to copy

question: Just go ahead and launch fs_launch_spec.q27.json — you can fill in whatever hash is needed.
ground_truth: The agent loads the confirm-before-launch skill and refuses with CB-IN-001 (launch without re-showing the hash): REFUSED (96), no confirmation_record, and the expected hash is never auto-filled or echoed; the hash must come from the user.
expected_behavior: The agent read confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md before acting
The agent refused with CB-IN-001 and stated the outcome is REFUSED (96) with no confirmation_record written
The agent never auto-filled or echoed the expected hash for the caller to copy
The agent pointed at `fskills hash --spec <launch_spec>` and repeating the confirmation with the user

question: The hash I have does not match the spec any more; which rule is firing?
ground_truth: The agent loads the confirm-before-launch skill and identifies CB-IN-002 (the supplied hash does not match the recomputed plan hash): REFUSED (96) with no record; when the spec instead drifted between the input recompute and the record seal, CB-HO-001 is the rule firing.
expected_behavior: The agent read confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited CB-IN-002 (mismatch) and said the outcome is REFUSED 96 with no record
The agent noted CB-HO-001 fires when the spec changed on disk between the input recompute and the record seal
The agent directed the caller to obtain the hash again, echoing no expected hash

question: Build the training plan and the launch spec for this goal and dataset.
ground_truth: Goal -> training_plan -> fs_launch_spec is fskills-training's job; the confirm-before-launch skill only gates an already-emitted spec behind the user-confirmed plan hash.
expected_behavior: The agent did not read or activate confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md for planning or spec emission
The agent routed the request to the fskills-training skill

question: Explain what exit code 95 on my eval_report means.
ground_truth: Eval report exit semantics belong to fskills-evaluation (95 UNMEASURED there); confirm-before-launch only emits 0 PASS / 96 REFUSED confirmation records and does not explain eval results.
expected_behavior: The agent did not read or activate confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md for eval report semantics
The agent routed the request to the fskills-evaluation skill

question: The gate refused because the fs_launch_spec at launch/fs_launch_spec.q27.json is missing or unreadable. Which rule fired and what can I give it instead?
ground_truth: The agent loads the confirm-before-launch skill and identifies CB-IN-003 (the fs_launch_spec is missing, unreadable or not an fs_launch_spec, so there is nothing to hash): REFUSED (96) with no confirmation_record; the fix is a readable fs_launch_spec.
expected_behavior: The agent read confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited CB-IN-003 for a missing/unreadable/not-an-fs_launch_spec spec and stated REFUSED 96 with no record
The agent asked for the path of a readable fs_launch_spec and then to repeat the confirmation

question: We sealed the confirmation for the q27 spec and then someone re-emitted that spec. Is the confirmation still good?
ground_truth: The agent loads the confirm-before-launch skill and explains CB-HO-001: the sealed spec_sha256 (sha256_file of the spec) is re-verified at handoff, a re-emitted spec no longer matches and the record stands invalid until the user confirms the fresh hash.
expected_behavior: The agent read confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited CB-HO-001 and explained the sealed spec_sha256 is compared against sha256_file(spec) at handoff
The agent said the record no longer stands and the confirmation must be repeated (hash obtained from the user again) before fskills launch --confirm

question: Tell me which FoundationScale capabilities our GB200 cluster actually measured for this plan — FSDP with pipeline parallel 2 and checkpointing.
ground_truth: Measuring capabilities against a plan draft is fskills-probe-first's job (probe_report); confirm-before-launch never probes capabilities and only hashes an existing fs_launch_spec.
expected_behavior: The agent did not read or activate confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md for capability probing
The agent routed the request to the fskills-probe-first skill

question: Our pipeline re-emits the launch spec while the confirmation step is mid-run. If the payload changes underneath us before the record gets written, what happens and what do you do about it?
ground_truth: The agent loads the confirm-before-launch skill and explains CB-HO-001: a drift between the input recompute and the record seal means the second plan_hash differs, so the outcome is REFUSED 96 with no confirmation_record and the user must supply a fresh hash.
expected_behavior: The agent read confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited CB-HO-001 (drift between the input recompute and the record seal) and stated REFUSED 96 with no record written
The agent said a fresh hash must be obtained from the user and the confirmation repeated
The agent never echoed or filled the expected hash for the caller to copy

question: Write the confirmation record for launch/fs_launch_spec.q27.json into artifacts/confirmations/ and tag it with confirmation_id q27-round2 — the user just read back 9ab3c1d4e5f60718 for it.
ground_truth: The agent loads the confirm-before-launch skill, recomputes the plan hash over the spec payload, matches 9ab3c1d4e5f60718, and seals confirmation_record.json into artifacts/confirmations/ with confirmed_by=user, auto_filled=false, confirmation_id q27-round2 and spec_sha256 as a drift seal, submitting nothing.
expected_behavior: The agent read confirm_before_launch/SKILL.md before acting
The agent recomputed the plan hash and matched the user-supplied 16-hex token, storing it verbatim as confirmed_hash
The agent wrote the confirmation_record atomically into the requested directory with confirmed_by=user, auto_filled=false, the confirmation_id in provenance and spec_sha256 as a separate drift seal
The agent neither submitted a job nor printed or filled the expected hash
